title: Michael H FDE 5278 NDE 5278
content: While crossing a highway to get to a bus stop, I was pushed from behind by a non-physical entity. I felt it behind me and looked back to see a shiny sharp toothed grin and a hand push me at the base of my spine. I was thrown forward into traffic and jumped at the last moment but was still struck in the lower legs. As I flew through the air, I was transported to a dimension of void or limitlessness where everything was very quiet and peaceful. I felt an overwhelming sense that this was indeed my death, and it did not bother me in that space one bit. Time was incredibly distorted, and for about ten minutes I watched the void, waiting for what came next. An indigo light appeared as a field surrounding me from the furthest reaches of this 'space' and I became aware that I was a luminous body, transparent and gossamer. This indigo light was very far away but surrounded me on all sides like a bubble. It briefly turned orange and then began to close in on me, getting closer and closer over the course of the next twenty minutes. As it surrounded me closely, I could reach out my luminous arm and submerge it in this 'light of death' up to the elbow. I lost my sense of calm and fearlessness and became agitated. Turning every which way, I found myself unable to escape the field which surrounded me. As the light crept inside my luminous body and towards my heart, I screamed a silent scream 'NOT MY TIME YET' and simultaneously stuck my middle finger up at the light. I mentally invented a surface under my ethereal feet which I pushed off of backwards in a back flip motion, looking backwards and upside down into this blinding white light. All of a sudden, I was back in my body, still flying through the air and I landed in the middle of the highway, almost run down by another car. Amazingly, I dematerialized at the last moment and rematerialized by the side of the highway, where I lay in agony waiting for the ambulance. I remember seeing from my body my spirit standing outside it, and then it was back inside me. I was completely lucid throughout the entirety of the experience, and only lost consciousness in the ambulance, to wake eight days later in the hospital with my legs stabilized by surgery (rods and pins).

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Experienced being in a 'dimension of void or limitlessness' and later saw 'my spirit standing outside' his body.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Initially 'very quiet and peaceful' and unbothered by death; later became 'agitated' as the light closed in.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Described being 'transported' to a void/limitlessness rather than traveling through a tunnel.

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'dimension of void or limitlessness' that was 'very quiet and peaceful'; an indigo light-field appeared surrounding him like a bubble, briefly turned orange, then became a 'blinding white light.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Pedestrian struck by a vehicle after being pushed into traffic.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also described an encounter just before the event with a 'non-physical entity' that pushed him into traffic.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Accident/impact coincided with immediate transport to a void; later a surrounding light-field approached; return occurred abruptly back into the body mid-air.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Return to body occurred while still 'flying through the air' during the accident sequence.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported being pushed by a 'non-physical entity' with a 'shiny sharp toothed grin' and feeling a hand push at the base of the spine; reported 'dematerialized at the last moment and rematerialized by the side of the highway'; described mentally inventing a surface under his feet to push off from within the void/light encounter.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “transported to a dimension of void or limitlessness where everything was very quiet and peaceful.” “NOT MY TIME YET” “I was a luminous body, transparent and gossamer.” “I dematerialized at the last moment and rematerialized by the side of the highway.”
